# Techvinex

> Techvinex is an AI-powered job and hiring platform connecting top professionals with leading companies through AI matching, vetted opportunities, referrals, and remote-first roles.

Techvinex helps job seekers discover relevant roles and grow their careers, while giving employers a vetted pipeline of qualified candidates via AI screening and structured interviews. The platform also hosts Atlas, an AI model benchmarking suite, and a blog covering AI, hiring, and careers.

## Pages

- [Home / Explore Jobs](/explore): Browse and search AI-curated job opportunities across engineering, AI, design, product, and data.
- [Opportunities](/opportunities): Full list of open roles from vetted employers.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on AI, hiring trends, career growth, and Atlas benchmark insights.
- [Sign in](/login): Candidate sign-in and account access.
- [For Employers](/employer/login): Employer portal for posting roles and reviewing candidates.
- [Atlas Benchmark](/benchmark/login): AI model performance benchmarking platform.
